# Triggers of Zol's Mistake and the pace-shifted floor dates (zin_zol_after_<name>).
zin_is_zol = {
	original_tag = ZOL
}
zin_kusven_can_come_forth = {
	has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_kusven_forth }
	has_war = yes
	check_variable = { var = zin_zol_convergence value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { var = zin_mistake_power value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}
zin_kusven_is_forth = {
	has_global_flag = zin_kusven_forth
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_kusven_withdrawn }
}
zin_zol_ai_keeps_history = {
	is_ai = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = HISTORICAL }
			zin_rules_is_historical = yes
		}
		has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = AGGRESSIVE }
	}
}
zin_zol_ai_route_appointed = {
	has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = HISTORICAL }
	NOT = { zin_rules_is_free = yes }
}
zin_zol_ai_route_hastened = {
	has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = AGGRESSIVE }
}
zin_zol_ai_route_patience = {
	has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = RESTRAINED }
}
zin_zol_can_rise = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_zol_presence_lapsed }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { var = zin_mistake_power value = 55 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = zin_zol_islands_stirring value = zin_zol_islands_needed compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = zin_zol_route_appointed
					zin_zol_after_appointed_hour = yes
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = zin_zol_route_hastened
					zin_zol_after_hastened_hour = yes
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = zin_zol_route_patience
					has_country_flag = zin_zol_greater_hour
					zin_zol_after_greater_hour = yes
				}
			}
		}
		# someone attacked him first: power, island and date limits are ignored, and so is the Unending Patience
		AND = {
			has_war = yes
			any_enemy_country = { always = yes }
		}
	}
}
# zin_zol_after_appointed_hour: 1755.5.1 at the standard pace, shifted by zin_story_pace
zin_zol_after_appointed_hour = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 }
			date > 1758.11.29
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.875 }
			date > 1753.7.15
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0 }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.875 }
					check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 1.25 }
				}
			}
			date > 1755.4.30
		}
	}
}
